steps.name: Cat Detective (1)
steps.objective: Turn in the quest to [Parmila] in 「Oscuras Temporary Camp」.

steps.name: Cat Detective (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Parmila] in 「Oscuras Temporary Camp」, then turn in the quest to [Jubil] in 「Glaston Central Plaza」.

lines.text: (Somewhere between the cracks of time, at a moment impossible to place precisely.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Sigh, another busy day.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: It's not as though anyone told you to accept so many requests, Captain...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Callone, call me your esteemed captain.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Yes, esteemed... Captain.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Good. How am I supposed to run the mercenary company without taking jobs?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Are we far short of the target?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yes, we are.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...How much more do we need?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: About as much as Lashur, the richest man in Silvaria, perhaps?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: That sounds impossible even if we were reborn several times and worked every day without rest...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It's a figure of speech. Come on, let's find a cat.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Is it a real cat this time? Last time you said cat, you meant the princess.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Shiina is an adorable little kitten. Now, now. Let's look at the most urgent request first. Yes, a cat. Meow.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: It's anonymous. Let's see...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: 「A little while ago, I came home to find my beloved little ones missing: 'Mungchi,' a prickly gray cat, and 'Potato,' a round, medium-sized dog.」

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: 「The two have entered the Nectar Circus and will not come out.」

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I remember the Nectar Circus. The boss took me to a performance, and I was so happy...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I've never seen it, but I understand it's quite famous.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Callone, keep reading.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: 「I cannot bring them back myself, so I am submitting this request to your mercenary company.」

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: If they need mercenaries because they can't get them back themselves, the circus must be rather dangerous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hello, %s. Welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Looking for a cat again?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...Again?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Captain, you've been calling %s to help find cats...?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Only when we had too many requests. %s said it was fine too. Right, %s? Hurry and say it's fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it's fine.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Sigh. Understood...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s, anyway, you've come at the right time. Let's handle this together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Potato and Mungchi... Cute names.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: You'll help, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I happen to be free. But do you know where the Nectar Circus is?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Jubil recently visited Glaston. She says the circus finished its continental tour and returned there.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Oh, Glaston...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Don't worry. It'll be fine. %s is with us too.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: You aren't planning to leave everything to %s, are you?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: No, we'll all solve it together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We're just bringing back a cat and a dog. What could go seriously wrong?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Sigh. I hope nothing happens...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Jubil needs to return to Glaston too, so let's all go together. Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sounds good.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Captain, are you that happy about going to Glaston?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yes. We're going as a group. I'm so excited my heart is fluttering.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...Then I'm glad...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hm?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Nothing... Let's prepare.

steps.name: Cat Detective (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Jubil] in 「Glaston Central Plaza」, then turn in the quest to [Romalius] in 「LaChouette Slums」.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: Shall we finish these drinks and split up? We still aren't entirely free to act. There's a famous adventurer here too, and plenty of eyes on us. All right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Well, our friend did save Eastland from destruction.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm no hero. The others are much more impressive. Where are you going, Jubil?

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: I have a business deal.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: A deal...?

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: I'm meeting Jewelstar, who compiles a jewel encyclopedia. My family has an abandoned gem mine, and I'm going to take Jewelstar there.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: If we find what's needed, I've been promised this much. It should help with what the captain is doing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Oh, that's a secret...

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: You told everyone when the company was together. Too many people know for it to be a secret...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hehe, that's true.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: There are more children like me on the continent than I expected. I'm thinking of creating a place that helps them grow up safely...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's wonderful.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...It's a good thing, but please don't overextend yourself...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 쥬빌
lines.text: I'll be going, then. Don't cry because you miss me.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Let's go too. Where did they say it was?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I asked the young flower seller. He said a circus tent went up on LaChouette Street recently.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Apparently it's quite large, so it should be easy to find.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Callone, let's watch the circus while we're there!

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: We didn't come for fun, but... A little while should be fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Come to think of it, I've never really watched a circus... Shall I have a look?)

steps.name: Cat Detective (4)
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Romalius] in 「LaChouette Slums」, then enter 「Nectar Circus」.
2. Defeat [Potato] and [Mungchi] in 「Nectar Circus」 and resolve the situation, then go outside and turn in the quest to [Romalius].

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I've never had a part-time job like this. I'm nervous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Romalius?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: %s? I never expected to see you here... Good to see you.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s, what's with that man? Horns...? Don't tell me...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Oh, young lady, can you see my horns? I thought the Order's priests had taken care of that.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: %s, who is this gentleman?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He lives in Invernel... Oh, how much should I explain?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Why think so hard? Haha. I'm Romalius, down from Invernel for a part-time job.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: All the way from Invernel for a job? Isn't that awfully far?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Callone, can you see what's on his head?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Don't tell me he has some sort of spirit halo?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: So you can't see it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Callone can't see it, other people probably can't either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Romalius, did you get the Order's permission to come here?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Of course. With permission from the village representative and the Order, the priests all rushed in to cast something that would hide my horns.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I was deeply moved that everyone wanted to help me become independent. That's how I was able to come all this way.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Though the scenery was so beautiful that I nearly got lost.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of job brought you here?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: A priest I'd never seen before asked me to find the demonic beasts Alexandra and Jennifer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait. Demonic beasts?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Are those beasts you're talking about here, mister?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: You seem to treat me like an ordinary human man, young lady. I like that. I'm in a good mood, so I'll answer.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Even without my magic, I can still smell demonic beasts a little. See over there? I can faintly smell them inside.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Alexandra and Jennifer... What sort of creatures are they? Like the ones my brother keeps?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: He keeps demonic beasts?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: My brother has a terrible temper, but he showers the beasts with affection. He takes in abandoned ones, walks them four hours a day, and plays with them.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Wow, that's amazing.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: What on earth am I listening to...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha. Callone, let it go in one ear and out the other.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Romalius, what do you intend to do with those beasts?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: With my current strength, I can neither subdue them nor take them away. I'll just confirm they're here and return. The client said he'd handle the rest.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: If I had a little strength, I could subdue them and collect extra hazard pay. What a shame.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: What brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We took a request. A cat and dog are apparently trapped inside and can't get out.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Oh, how distressing.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Mister, while we're here, we're going to watch the circus too. After we find the cat and dog, of course.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Circus? What's that?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Performers come out and do tricks, and tame animals dance.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Oh, how fascinating. Does it cost money to watch?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: You have to buy a ticket.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I'll just do my job and head back, then.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Why don't we go in together? We'll find the cat and dog, and you can check whether the beasts are there.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Let's leave all the dangerous parts to %s.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Good idea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me. Does anyone want to hear my opinion?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...I believe it can't be helped.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Then let's all go inside.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: The circus's interior is quite splendid.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never thought the tent would be this spacious. How will we find a cat and dog in such a huge place?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: The venue is larger than it looks. It seems as though dozens of demonic beasts could rampage without damaging it...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Shall we call their names as we search?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: You two. Shh. Wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...Pardon?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Romalius, what is it?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Callone, come here.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Something hasn't gone wrong, has it?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: That's Callone for you. So quick to catch on.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: The young lady knows something.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I don't know much, but I know it's strange. What we're seeing is thousands, tens of thousands of times larger than an ordinary tent.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Is someone playing a trick?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It seems to be an artificially created space. We'd better change our plan.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: You two, apart from %s. You value your lives, don't you?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yes, we do.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Alexandra!! Jennifer!!
(When Romalius loudly calls the beasts' names, the space around the group trembles.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: You two should leave. To my eyes, you look much more suitable as beast snacks than %s does.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: How can you say that with a smile?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Mister, don't scare Callone.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Captain, let's leave. Money is good, but life comes first.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: If you say so, Callone. All right, we'll leave.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: %s. Let's go on, just the two of us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I value my life too, you know...?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: You can handle a few dozen demonic beasts easily.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hehe. Don't be shy. Find Mungchi and Potato for us.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I'm sorry, %s. We'll wait outside.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Hmm. They've both gone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: This place seems designed so that once you leave, you can't enter again...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Romalius, what about the cat and dog?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Call their names loudly. Go on.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Try it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, then... Mungchi!! Potato!!
(The circus suddenly shakes far more violently than when the beasts' names were called. An ear-splitting roar follows.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I think Mungchi the cat and Potato the dog are the demonic beasts Alexandra and Jennifer...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do we do?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: We have you here, %s, so we should catch them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since when did finding them include defeating them?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Defeating beasts usually earns a bigger bounty than confirming their location. Let me benefit from your skills while we're here, %s.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: If we don't catch them now, they might escape and rampage outside. We can't let them harm the goddess's cause, can we?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh... All right. Let's catch them.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Good. I'll call their names as we go. That should help us find them quickly.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: This is the only place left where Mungchi could be.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That 'bear' called Potato seemed like an ordinary demon... Why was it called a demonic beast? And why a dog?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It called me a traitor, so it's an intelligent, speaking demon. Neither a beast nor a dog...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Let's not overthink it. Creatures like those are a threat to people as long as they're here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's true, but...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Do you mind if I take some of the things they drop when defeated?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's fine. What will you use them for?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I'll sell them to help with living expenses. Now, let's defeat Mungchi.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That demon really hated being called 'Potato,' didn't it?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Of course. Demons who were once beastfolk hate being treated like animals. Many crossed into the Demon Realm and became demons for that very reason.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: If someone gave such demons pet names, that person must be unusual or stronger than they are...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Come to think of it, it hated Jennifer too. What's wrong with Jennifer? It suited it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, then if we call Mungchi 'Alexandra'...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Mungchi! Alexandra! Where are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Romalius, wait...
Crash.
(Something falls with a tremendous noise before %s as you scan the surroundings. Looking ahead, you see a crumpled steel beam that had supported the circus.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A tiger beastfolk...)
How dare you imprison me and give me such a name!

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: So you're Mungchi Alexandra.

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: My name is Scara, proud warrior of the Demon Realm! Not a cute ball of fluff, and not the beautiful Alexandra!! Huh?

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: Romalius the traitor? What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: You know me?

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: Who wouldn't know the high-ranking demon who murdered Demon Realm residents and fled? Grrrr.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: They attacked me, threatening to kill me when I was doing nothing. I only defended myself. How is that murder?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Well... Never mind, Mungchi Alexandra.

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: Don't call me that. Grrrr.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Your character introduction probably already says 'Mungchi.' And that's what the speech bubble says right now too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Romalius, what are you talking about?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Somehow, it felt like the right thing to say here. Still, you have more dialogue than Potato Jennifer.

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: Potato Jennifer? Do you mean Laika? Where is Laika now?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: My friend here defeated him on the way in.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're the one who told me to attack first, Romalius.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Splendid work, just what I'd expect from %s, whose name is known in the Demon Realm.

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: %s? That %s? Grrrr.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And you kept making the defeated Potato drink holy water.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: What could be better than praying for a demon's soul? Holy water should help it reach a better place rather quickly.

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: Laika... How dare you do that to Laika... Grrrr!

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: By the way, why are you here?

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: I won't tell a traitor so much as a whisker of information. If you insist on hearing it, defeat me first. Grrrr!!
(As Mungchi roars, the circus interior shakes.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: A ball of fluff refusing even a whisker of information. How fitting...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Romalius, stop provoking Mungchi.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: %s, I'll leave this to you. I'll hide back there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. All right. I suppose we'll have to defeat him before we hear why...

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: Impossible...
Crash.
(Mungchi crumples under %s's blow.)

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: Scara, proud warrior of the Demon Realm, beaten by a human like this...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Of course you lost. This is no ordinary human. This is the goddess's follower.

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: Romalius, you traitor...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did you come here from the Demon Realm?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Mungchi Alexandra Scara. Tell us why you came, as promised.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (His name keeps getting longer...)

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: To wipe out the humans and place Etoile beneath the demons' feet...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: How predictable. It doesn't look like Barbatos sent you. Lux again, I suppose.

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: Lord Lux did not order this. We came to earn distinction and become legion commanders...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: %s, what shall we do with him? The same as Potato?

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: Cough, cough...
(Mungchi coughs blood and tries to hold on, but the approaching pain overwhelms him. He loses consciousness and collapses.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: We'll have to leave him. Mungchi Alexandra Scara will die like this. Whoever imprisoned him probably never intended to let him live.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: You're human, so you can't sense it, but this space is filled with the scent of Cantarella, one of the Demon Realm's most potent poisons.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It seems modified to kill only demons.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you know?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: My brother once made large quantities of Cantarella to drive off our attackers. Back then, I drank it with the Order's holy water to build resistance.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Well, I don't know if I gained resistance, but it did strip away my magic. Perhaps that's why I'm all right here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad you're all right, but what about our requests...?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Good point. They aren't a cat and dog, or beasts we can collect payment for...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It can't be helped. We'll have to report that the jobs failed.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Don't worry too much about this space. Once we leave, we won't be able to enter again either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Don't overthink things. Do that, and there won't be any part-time jobs you can take. Now, shall we go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Even if I try not to overthink it, something feels wrong...)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Whew, outside. I never like the smell of Cantarella. Huh, strange. The smell hasn't gone away even out here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Romalius, look over there.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Andrea?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Just a passing demon... I mean, you've got the wrong person.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Did you feed Hellfire before leaving? One of them has separation anxiety, remember?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Of course. I fed them and walked them, so they'll be fine for a few hours.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Andrea, why are you here? Tell us properly.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: It can't be helped. You've recognized me, so I'll explain. I only came to catch the runaways. I'll take them back through Lysithea's Gate.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Oh, Potato Jennifer Laika and Mungchi Alexandra Scara.

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: Grrrr. I told you not to call us that.

lines.speaker: 감자
lines.text: Rooooar... Andrea, are you with the ones who poured holy water over us and tried to kill us?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Oh, neither of you died. You nearly died at %s's hands.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me...

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: What were your names? Potato and Mungchi? If you don't want to die here, be quiet. Potato-Mungchi!

lines.speaker: 감자
lines.text: Tch.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Where around here does Lysithea's Gate connect?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't tell me... Pseudaria?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Anyway. I have no intention of causing trouble here. Move aside.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: One question. Why are Potato-Mungchi here?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: From what I heard, the human circus director mistook them for large animals instead of demons and lured them with food.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: How laughable for supposedly proud demons to be won over by mere feed. I can give them more than enough of that.

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: Potato... I mean, Laika! Don't fall for it!

lines.speaker: 감자
lines.text: I pledge my loyalty, Lord Andrea!

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I'll judge that by your behavior once we're inside Lysithea's Gate. Still, it should be easier than serving Belial.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Oh, you were under Belial? Then I understand. Andrea, do you know the priest who asked me to look for Jennifer and Alexandra?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: That elf priest? Something about the youngest fifth-rank...

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Lysithea's Gate was open, so I went to close it. Some elf priest was peering inside, and our eyes met.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: He went on about falling short of his quota, and how he'd ruin my life if I refused a deal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A priest...?)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I told him to try me, and he brought a whole force of battle priests. They tried to force the gate open and purify the inside, so I had no choice but to agree.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: If I fail to protect that place while Lux's binding remains...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: So you submitted.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I did not!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Save the brotherly quarrel for later. What was the deal?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: ...He wanted me to remove one of the doors inside and give it to him. A prayer-room door at the Order's temple was broken and needed replacing. As though all doors were the same.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Then he told me to take these two away myself. Said he'd already taken suitable measures...

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I don't know what kind of human that circus director is, but he certainly bound these fools well. That's all. Finished.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And if you're lying?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Then you may kill me here.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: %s, we should let him go. He isn't lying.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: And here come your two friends.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: There you both are. Wh-What is all this?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Are these Potato and Mungchi too?
(As Potato and Mungchi begin to snarl at the humans, Andrea raises a hand.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Sit.

lines.speaker: 뭉치
lines.text: Andrea, even so, we are...

lines.speaker: 감자
lines.text: I'll sit, Lord Andrea! You sit too. Do you want to go back to Belial?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Good. Here, a treat.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Now go. Don't come back.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: You won't see me again, little brother.
(Andrea produces an enormous door from somewhere, sets it in front of the circus, opens it, and takes Potato and Mungchi through.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Wow, amazing. Is that part of the circus too? It vanished as soon as they went in.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I don't think so. That was...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Let's go too. We found Potato and Mungchi, after all.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Their owner must cherish them greatly. We received quite a large sum.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They really were a dog and cat?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: They must have had the same names. The real Potato looked like a potato, and Mungchi looked like a ball of fluff.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I'm so happy we got that much money just for finding a cat and dog.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, that's good, but...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Mister, you like earning lots of money too, right?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Of course! Hehe.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s, listen. For today, let's sweet-talk him into treating us to lots of good food.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Mister, I know some great restaurants in Glaston.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Oh, now that's good news.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I'll have a quick word with %s, then lead the way.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Wow... To visit the famous Glaston restaurants I've only heard about. This country-village demon has come up in the world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... Is this really all right...? Huh, Parmila?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Oh, right. Your fee. Is this enough?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sounds good.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Thank you. Today, we're having a company dinner! Understood? Don't go anywhere!!

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Captain!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hehe, what? Don't you like company dinners, Callone?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: That's not it. If you're happy, Captain, then it's a good thing. Let's go.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: A human company dinner... I'm deeply moved.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm hungry... Sigh. Somehow, I feel something like this will happen again next time... It'll be all right, won't it?
